 RADAR: Heavy rain prompts several flood warnings, estimated 8-10″ fall in Broward County 
 The combination of a front stalled just to the north and deep moisture sliding in from the west and south will keep rain chances high. 
 By Adam Berg and NBC6 • 
 Published November 17, 2026 • 
 Updated 3 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 Meteorologist Steve MacLaughlin has the latest forecast Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.
 Several Flash Flood Warnings were in effect in South Florida on Tuesday night, as well as an ongoing flood watch, due to a very moist and unstable pattern that could last through at least Thursday.
 The flood watch is in effect in Miami-Dade, Broward and parts of Palm Beach counties until Thursday evening as the forecast calls for multiple inches of rain. Some isolated spots could see amounts closer to 10 inches. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 The National Weather Service issued several Flash Flood Warnings in parts of Broward and Miami-Dade on Tuesday night. Some warnings last until early Wednesday. See all active weather alerts here . 
 An estimated 8-10 inches of rain fell in three hours across portions of Broward County, the NWS said. One-inch hail also fell in Hollywood.
 3-Hour rainfall *estimates* between 8-10" across portions of Broward County tonight. 
Significant street flooding is likely occurring in portions of this area. Use extreme caution driving! https://t.co/ZdAcKz3Rzj
— NWS Miami (@NWSMiami) November 18, 2026 
 The combination of a front stalled just to the north and deep moisture sliding in from the west and south will keep rain chances high.

 Models are a little conflicted, but the trend is for drier skies later this week and into the weekend, but this certainly bears watching. 
 In addition to the periods of heavy rain, we are expecting gusty winds to continue as well. We are under a small craft advisory, a high surf advisory for Broward and we also expect issues with rip currents this week.
 Future forecast
 Wednesday: Widespread showers, locally heavy rainfall possible. Windy. 81°
 Thursday: Scattered showers, a few storms. Breezy. 82°
 Friday: Partly cloudy, a few showers.  84°
 Saturday: Partly cloudy, slight chance for a shower.  84°
